issues.on_page: Visitors Promotion 900 'Property tax' 893,932; Visitors Promotion Improvements 995 'Property tax' 893,932
issues.issue: Only a person can settle this. Two equal 893,932 amounts in the two visitors promotion funds (1,787,864, which is 3,500 short of p2 Lodging 1,791,364) look like the statutory lodging-tax split, and the 'Property tax' row label may just come from the template. The General Fund piece detail[3] (taxes (unlabeled) 1,787,864) is property tax if the fund name wins, or lodging tax if the printed row label wins. If the fund name wins, detail[106] (nonmajor 'Property tax' 3,301,155) would also need splitting into property 1,513,291 + lodging 1,787,864.
The budget for the whole Taxes line is put on the property piece, and the motor vehicle, lodging and unlabeled pieces carry null. So the property piece's budget variance is misleading.

issues.on_page: Other (Road Fund column) 180,031; Road Fund schedule p9 'Local' 180,031
issues.issue: Category inferred only because the amount equals 'Sale of surplus property 180,031' on p2; the Road Fund schedule labels it 'Local'. The matching detail line (detail[91], Road 'Local' 180,031) is category 'other', so the same money has two different categories

issues.on_page: Other: General 5,584,319 + Health Reserve 4,119,298 + Other Governmental 350,591
issues.issue: 10,054,208 left in 'other'. p2 shows Health Reserve's 4,119,298 as Public health operating grants and contributions, and the Statement of Activities shows charges for services of 3,135,934 (general government 2,539,926), probably most of the General Fund 'Local' 5,584,319. Defensible because the label is 'Other', but a specific category may fit

The State line probably includes property tax credit 1,927,835, homestead 706,641 and pro-rate motor vehicle 60,504 (p2 general receipts), which user rules keep out of state aid. No breakdown of this line is printed, so it was correctly not split

issues.on_page: Property tax: Visitors Promotion 900 893,932 + Visitors Promotion Improvements 995 893,932 (p13) inside Totals 3,301,155
issues.issue: Recorded as printed ('Property tax'), which is correct under the printed-label rule. 1,787,864 of it sits in the visitors promotion funds and may really be lodging tax (see decision_needed). With the corrected General Fund split, detail property tax totals 19,548,953 + 3,301,155 = 22,850,108, which equals p2, so nothing is double counted.
